label: Teltonika RUTM52
description: A dual-5G router: 1 WAN + 4 LAN at gigabit, dual-band Wi-Fi 5 and **two** 5G Sub-6 modems, so a site can bond or fail over between two 5G carriers.
notes: Vendor figures from the RUTM52 datasheet: 1 x WAN port 10/100/1000 Mbps and 4 x LAN ports 10/100/1000 Mbps; two 5G Sub-6 GHz SA/NSA modems at 2.1/3.3 Gbps downlink (4x4 MIMO) each, 900/600 Mbps uplink; 802.11b/g/n/ac Wave 2 (Wi-Fi 5) dual band up to 867 Mbps. Both cellular interfaces are modelled at 2.1G - the conservative end - because redundancy across two carriers is the reason this model exists.
